card.name: Upper bound digits in range tables
card.fires_on: The decimal point or the 9 inside an upper range limit such as 19.9, 14.9 or 999 in dosing and lab-value tables. It fires where the number is about to end in repeated nines.

modes.label: Decimal point before .9
modes.description: The period in an upper limit like 39.9 kg or 14.9 mcg/mL in a weight or concentration range.
modes.example: 10 kg to 19.9 kg 2.5 mg 10 mg 5 mg 20 kg to 39<<.>>9 kg 3 mg 12

modes.label: Nines in count limits
modes.description: A 9 within an upper limit like 999 or 99,999 in blood count ranges.
